doc.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021

title: Hotel quarantine in Sydney and upcoming gigs
summary: Lisa describes mandatory Covid hotel quarantine in Sydney and rehearsing with friends she has played with since 1988.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Okay so yes I live and I’m based in Brooklyn, New York and have been for, since, well I’ve been in New York since the mid-90s. But at the moment I’m actually in a mandatory hotel quarantine in Sydney, Australia, so I can hang out with Mom and Dad. And they’ve had that in place in Australia, the Covid 19 restrictions, everybody who comes in, and only returning Australians — because I have a, I’m a dual citizen I’m allowed to come in but I’m also able to leave. If you’re a resident of another country you’re not allowed in or, and Australians aren’t allowed out. That’s how intense it is. I feel very grateful that I’m actually, that I’m doing this. You know I’ve had to take a million different Covid tests to even get to this point and I’ve been vaccinated but that doesn’t even mean anything. But anyway, I’m in Sydney and I’m halfway through quarantine.
Will you be able to hook up with any of the musicians that you played with during your formative years?

I was just texting, I’m having a rehearsal, like literally I’m going from here to a rehearsal, which I’m very excited about. The stars have aligned in that they’re both available that day so I’m going to go from here to rehearsing with two friends that I’ve been playing with since 1988, which is — yeah, so we have a gig a week Friday in Sydney, then we have a gig in my hometown of Newton Castle, which is where Mom and Dad are, and then a gig later in the month back in Sydney.
